comparison.objective: Remove and discard an old vacuum bag, seat a new bag collar, and close the vacuum.
comparison.physical_skill: Bag extraction, thin collar alignment into channels, seating, and lid latching versus rigid screen agitation.
comparison.success_condition: Old bag in wastebasket, new collar started then fully seated, lid shut/latched, hands clear for 1 s; drops and vacuum displacement cap credit.
comparison.reason: Tests consumable replacement and channel insertion.
